title: MSX/OutRun arcade arena presentation
problem_statement: The current canvas presentation still reads as empty/space-like and onion spawning is not visually connected to gates or wave queue state; evolve it toward a minimal retro asphalt/terrain arcade arena with visible gates, queued onion previews, a stronger right status panel, and continuous level feedback.
game_flow_context: fixed arena / finite waves / gate spawning / queued pressure / right HUD / continuous level transitions / lightning accelerator feedback
validated_decisions: Fixed-arena / finite wave model remains the strategic direction.
Runtime arena rotation remains rejected.
Difficulty must keep maxAliveOnions, totalOnions, spawnIntervalMs, and existing onion pressure semantics intact.

Normal level transition is already non-blocking in the wave-completion path: main.js resets to the next level, plays level-up SFX, shows level-toast, updates HUD, and does not call showLevelOverlay() there.
The legacy level-overlay DOM and showLevelOverlay() function still exist and isOverlayActive() still includes it; goto/debug and other overlay flows must remain intact.
Speed Dot / lightning accelerator already exists as a singleton power-up with shared boost duration and multiplier through LevelManager config defaults.
Pi-chan and onion boost rings already exist and deplete from entity boost remaining ratio.
Current background generation in js/ui/canvas.js uses blue/purple radial glows plus star-like dots; this conflicts with the requested no-space/no-galaxy direction.
Current draw pipeline clips to the arena, draws backgroundCanvas inside the clip, draws speed dot, onions, player, then arena border; outside the arena is not a separate terrain layer.
Current onion spawn uses random world edge positions and then arena.constrainCircle(...); it is not gate-based.
LevelManager.getWaveProgress() already exposes queuedOnions, so HUD and queued preview can be read-only derivations instead of new progression state.
LOG-002 gameplay-programmer is accepted as the implementation spec with one status correction: the spec is complete, but build remains unapproved.
Current code already contains partial terrain/gates/HUD/preview implementation in main.js, index.html, css/game.css, js/ui/canvas.js and optional asset manifest usage.
Main missing behavior is shared gate geometry for draw/spawn plus replacing random edge onion spawn with gate-based spawn.

Current draw order draws walls/gates before active entities and does not clip Speed Dot, onions, player, bullets or player explosions after arena floor drawing; LOG-002 correctly flags clip/order hardening.
Normal wave completion remains continuous and does not call showLevelOverlay() or engine.stop().

draft_assumptions_in_play: Gate spawning must consume the same wave budget at the same moment as current #spawnQueuedOnion; only spawn position/source changes.
Queued onion preview remains decorative and must not create entities, collisions, AI, or budget mutations.
Thread 006 behavior must be treated as existing work and must not be reverted.
The rework was limited to main.js because the blocker was drawQueuedOnionPreviews() placement, not spawn, budget, cadence, config, HUD, assets or entity behavior.
Full live playthrough items remain residual release-confidence checks, not blockers for DONE, because LOG-014 classified them as notes.
current_direction: LOG-014 APPROVE_WITH_NOTES is accepted as the final review gate.
No rework is required before DONE.
Residual manual checks remain recommended before release-level confidence.
explicit_non_goals: No moving arena, arena rotation, or runtime arena motion.
No new power-up system, multiple dots, or boost stacking.
No changes to bullet behavior, controls, collision rules, audio, online/network/presence, or existing goto/debug functionality.
No asset production unless a later owner explicitly proves canvas drawing cannot meet readability.
No blocking inter-level overlay for normal progression.
No HUD/CSS/canvas/background polish in this build.
No config tuning or schema changes.
approved_impact_surface: main.js - rework only decorative queued onion preview placement/drawing so markers are visible near gates on the primary rect arena; preserve read-only derivation from getWaveProgress().queuedOnions
candidate_impact_surface: main.js - draw order/clip hardening, import/use gate helper, avoid duplicating existing terrain/gate/HUD/preview helpers
js/core/LevelManager.js - replace random edge spawn coordinates inside #spawnQueuedOnion only
js/core/ArenaGates.js - optional new pure helper for shared gate geometry and spawn coordinate resolution
js/ui/canvas.js - avoid unless impact guard finds current terrain fallback still fails the no-space requirement
index.html - avoid unless HUD markup has a proven narrow issue
css/game.css - avoid unless HUD/readability has a proven narrow issue
js/entities/Player.js - avoid; only visual ring readability if proven
js/entities/Onion.js - avoid; only visual ring readability if proven
backward_compatibility_concerns: LevelManager.#spawnQueuedOnion currently owns budget increment and onion construction; gate spawning must not alter wave timing or count semantics.
main.js draw order currently clips all background/entity drawing to arena; introducing outside terrain requires explicit layer order to avoid hiding entities or border.
The right HUD is DOM-owned and pointer-events none; new HUD fields must not capture input or resize the centered canvas incoherently.
level-overlay remains part of isOverlayActive(); normal wave completion must continue not calling it, while debug/goto flows must stay functional.
Current Speed Dot implementation lives under old speedDot names while rendered as lightning; broad rename is out of scope unless gameplay-programmer proves it is required for clarity.
Existing dirty runtime files include prior Player/Onion/LevelManager/main/index/css changes and must not be reverted.
LOG-002 status_proposal says IMPACT_ANALYSIS_DONE even though the canonical next step was IMPACT_ANALYSIS_REQUESTED; task-orchestrator accepted the spec but corrected the route.
LOG-004 narrows build approval to main.js, js/core/LevelManager.js and optional pure js/core/ArenaGates.js.
required_validations: Do not change config/levels.json; JSON parse is only required if scope is violated and config changes
local static server smoke on an unused port
PHPMD is not applicable unless PHP files/config are introduced or discovered
human_test_checklist: Verify level 1 starts without console errors.
Verify outside-arena area shows only ground/asphalt/terrain, not space/galaxy/nebula/deep sci-fi.
Verify arena floor is separately readable inside the arena.
Verify onions enter from gates and remain constrained validly.
Verify wave maxAliveOnions, totalOnions, spawnIntervalMs, and completion behavior remain intact.
Verify queued onions are visible outside the arena near gates and count equals totalOnions - spawnedOnions.
Verify right HUD shows level, opinion, next-level progress, onions cleared/total, queued count, Pi-chan boost state, and dot state if implemented.
Verify speed/lightning pickup can be collected by Pi-chan.
Verify onion can target/collect the pickup when convenient under existing thread 006 behavior.
Verify boost ring appears and depletes for Pi-chan and onion.
Verify normal level transition remains continuous and uses toast/HUD, not blocking level overlay.
Verify goto/debug level UI remains intact.
Verify game over, continue, pause/resume if present, collisions, bullets, and onion chase remain functional.
open_questions: None blocking for gameplay-programmer. If implementation confidence drops below 95%, ask one focused question before build approval.
solution_applied: Build-agent LOG-006 added shared gate geometry in js/core/ArenaGates.js, reused it from main.js and js/core/LevelManager.js, changed onion spawn origin to gates while preserving wave mutation ordering, and hardened active gameplay clipping/draw order.
Review-maintainability-guard LOG-008 required rework for queued preview visibility because primary rect arena previews were off-canvas.
Build-agent LOG-012 changed main.js only to clamp queued preview markers into visible canvas margins near rect arena gates.
